name: Cañaveral de León (Spain)
description: Red field with a purple stripe along the hoist with an undulating (nebuly) edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cañaveral de León (reeds on red and a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Cañaveral de León; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cañaveral de León arms — reeds on red and lion on white
